title: Universal GT28 Turbocharger Kit (T25 Flange, Intercooler, Piping & BOV)
description: This all-in-one universal boost kit gives you the essential hardware to force-feed small-displacement 1.5L to 2.0L engines for reliable 250 to 300+ horsepower setups. The core of the package is an internally wastegated GT28 turbo featuring a 49.2mm inducer / 71mm exducer compressor wheel in a responsive 0.60 A/R housing, paired with a fast-spooling 0.64 A/R T25 turbine housing to bring on boost early—around 2,500 to 2,800 RPM. Flowing approximately 30–33 lb/min of air at 7.5 to 14.5 PSI, it stays well within its peak thermal efficiency window without choking out top-end pull. The kit includes a 27x7x2.5-inch tube-and-fin intercooler, a complete 2.5-inch 6061 aluminum piping set with silicone couplers, a Type-RS blow-off valve, an adjustable manual boost controller, a 52mm gauge, and braided oil lines to complete your custom piping layout.
